blocks.text: Penicillin bacteria ko maarne ke liye yeh tareeqa apnati hai:

items: Bacteria ko nishana banana: penicillin sirf bacteria par asar karti hai, kyunke janwaron (aur insanon) ke cells mein woh cell wall hoti hi nahi jis par yeh dawa asar karti hai.
Cell wall ko rokna: yeh peptidoglycan (murein) ki zanjeeron ke aapas mein jurne (cross-linking) ko rok deti hai, is liye bacteria nayi cell wall nahi bana pate.
Bacterial cell ka phatna: kamzor cell wall cell ki shakal aur mazbooti qaim nahi rakh sakti aur cell phat jata hai (lysis). Is liye penicillin bacteria ko sirf rokti nahi, maar deti hai.
Resistance (muzahimat): kuch bacteria beta-lactamases jaise khaas enzymes bana kar apna bachao karte hain; yeh enzymes penicillin ko tor dete hain.

blocks.prompt: Penicillin insani cells ko nuqsan kyun nahi deti?
blocks.explanation: Yeh bacterial cell wall (peptidoglycan) ke banne par asar karti hai, aur insani (janwaron ke) cells mein cell wall nahi hoti.

items: Penicillin: Penicillium se, Fleming 1928; bactericidal; gram-positive bacteria ke khilaf behtareen.
Peptidoglycan ke cross-links rok kar cell wall kamzor karti hai, cell phat jata hai (lysis).
Beta-lactamases bacteria ko resistance dete hain.
